wrong_password: Wrong password, or no file in this folder uses it
tree_not_supported: Encrypted folders do not support recovery codes yet. Every file in a tree carries its own key slots, and whether a tree should share one code or hold one each is still undecided — set one on an individual file instead.
recovery_mismatch: The words themselves are fine, but they do not open this file — they may belong to a different file, or to an earlier code.
rewrite_verify_failed: The rewritten file failed its self-check, so nothing was written. Your original file is untouched.
bad_salt: The salt in the file header is malformed; the file may be damaged
no_vault_found: No encrypted files found in this folder
read_failed: Cannot read it — no permission, or the file is in use
write_failed: Cannot write — no permission, or the disk is full
io_error: Cannot read this folder, possibly no permission
no_omy_file_found: No omy encrypted files found in this folder
file_not_found: File not found; it may have been moved or deleted
empty_selection: Select the files to encrypt first
folder_not_supported: Encrypting folders is not supported yet
delete_failed: Encrypted, but the original file could not be deleted
trash_not_supported: Encrypted, but moving to trash is not implemented; the original was kept
unsupported: This platform does not support that
no_store_path: Cannot determine where to keep the device store
store_save_failed: Could not save the device store
bad_device_name: Invalid device name or pairing code
pair_failed: Pairing failed: wrong or expired code, or the other side is not omy
connect_failed: Could not reach the device. Check the address and network.
media_error_3: Decoding failed; the file may be damaged
media_error_4: This format cannot be played in the app
auth_expired: Authorization for this device has expired; pair again.
peer_not_found: Device not found on the network. Make sure sharing is on.
unauthorized: The device refused the connection; it may have revoked access.
remote_error: The device returned an error. Try again.
verify_failed: Post-encryption self-check failed; nothing was saved. Please report this.
open_failed: Couldn't open this file — there may be no associated app.
unknown_file: This file is no longer available. Try refreshing.
container_failed: Could not read the folder contents
same_password: The new password is the same as the current one
unexpected_new_password: This action does not take a new password
not_encrypted: This is not an omy encrypted file
rewrite_verify_failed: The rewritten file could not be opened with the new password; nothing was changed
corrupted: The file is damaged or has been tampered with
not_a_tree: No encrypted files were found in this folder; it may not be an encrypted folder.
tree_only_change: An encrypted folder shares one password across the whole tree, so the password can only be changed, not added or removed.
tree_partial: Some files could not be rewritten. The old password still opens them; run this again providing both passwords to finish the job.
storage_permission_lost: Cannot access device storage. All files access may have been turned off. Please grant it again from the sidebar.
storage_permission_query_failed: Could not check the storage permission state
storage_permission_request_failed: Could not open the system permission screen. Please enable All files access under Settings → Apps → omy.
